title: Frontend scaffold follow-ups — further non-blocking review follow-ups (PR #79)
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #79 (frontend-scaffold-followups), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's autonomous-pipeline rule so they aren't lost once that PR merges.

checklist.step: .storybook/preview.tsx wires every story to the app's real MUI theme (src/theme/theme.ts, which lists Inter first in typography.fontFamily) but never imports @fontsource/inter itself — only src/main.tsx does. Confirmed live in a browser (Storybook's common-percentchange--positive story, iframe.html): document.fonts registers only Storybook's own 'Nunito Sans' faces, zero Inter faces, so every component viewed in Storybook (the project's documented catalog for components/common/, per docs/architecture/Frontend.md §4) still silently falls back to a system font instead of Inter — the exact bug PR #61/#79's task set out to fix, just not closed for this consumption surface. Import the same @fontsource/inter weight CSS files (or a shared entry both main.tsx and preview.tsx import) in .storybook/preview.tsx so Storybook's rendering matches the real app.

docs/architecture/Frontend.md §6's Key Dependencies table doesn't list the @fontsource/inter dependency added to frontend/package.json in PR #79, leaving the table silently missing an entry for a real runtime dependency. Add a row, e.g. `@fontsource/inter | Self-hosted Inter font files, loaded once in main.tsx so the theme's declared font family actually renders`.
